advisor.settings.title: Advisor
advisor.settings.desc: The basics work out of the box; advanced knobs stay folded. Saved changes apply to the next consultation.
advisor.settings.mode.offHint: Never consult the advisor and never spend.
advisor.settings.mode.shadowHint: Calls the advisor and records it, but never puts advice into the conversation — useful for observing first.
advisor.settings.mode.advisoryHint: Calls the advisor and hands the advice to the model; the model may take it or ignore it.
advisor.settings.provider.none: The host returned no routes (llm service unavailable?)
advisor.settings.provider.stale: (current value is not in the route list)
advisor.settings.model.manualHint: Type an id if it is not listed; manual ids are not checked against the catalog.
advisor.settings.model.none: This route lists no models — type one manually
advisor.settings.model.stale: (current value is not in the model list)
advisor.settings.effort.none: This model declares no reasoning efforts
advisor.settings.effort.stale: (current value is not declared by the model)
advisor.settings.postAnswer.hint: Runs the advisor once after each answer; records advice only, never inserts it into the conversation. Costs an extra call.
advisor.settings.advisorToolsHint: Lets the advisor read files in the working directory to verify conclusions (up to 5 files, read-only); costs one extra model call.
advisor.settings.budget.workspaceHint: Workspace-wide: shared across sessions, resets on the local day
advisor.settings.scope.summaryHint: Sends a ~300-character conversation summary; no file contents.
advisor.settings.scope.fullHint: Sends the full context, truncated to the input limit.
advisor.settings.privacy.redactHint: Masks common key formats; it cannot guarantee every secret is caught.
advisor.settings.privacy.dedupeHint: In shadow mode, the same advice is recorded only once.
advisor.settings.advanced.temperatureHint: Empty = let the model decide; range 0–2.
advisor.settings.advanced.allowedModelsHint: Empty = no limit; accepts provider/model or a bare model id
advisor.settings.preview.title: Preview
advisor.settings.confirm.hint: Add the current provider to the confirmed list so cross-provider consultations stop being interrupted.
advisor.settings.status.title: Status
advisor.settings.error.unreachable: The host did not respond — try again later
advisor.settings.error.models: Could not load the model list
advisor.settings.error.modelInfo: Could not load the model's reasoning efforts
advisor.tail.title: Advisor
advisor.tail.declined: The advisor found nothing worth flagging
advisor.tail.anchors: Evidence anchors did not match ({checked} checked)
advisor.tail.aria: Advisor advice (click to expand or collapse)
advisor.settings.off.title: Advisor is off
advisor.settings.off.desc: It never calls the advisor and never spends.
advisor.settings.off.unconfigured: No advisor model selected yet. Choose “Configure advisor” to pick a provider and model.
advisor.settings.advanced.intro: Sensible defaults; you normally do not need to change these. Modified items show on the heading.
advisor.settings.advanced.resetHint: Only resets advanced fields; mode, provider, model and privacy stay.
advisor.settings.advanced.resetDone: Advanced settings restored to defaults (not saved yet).
advisor.settings.advanced.more: Rarely changed keys such as {fields} can be edited directly in the settings file.
advisor.settings.advanced.pathUnknown: The host did not return the settings file path.
advisor.settings.advanced.dailyBudgetNote: The daily budget is under Basics; this section has call and workspace-level limits.
advisor.settings.basic.budgetHint: 0 = unlimited; default 0, range 0–10000. Finer limits are under Advanced.
advisor.settings.budget.maxCostHint: Maximum spend per day; 0 = unlimited. Only counted when prices are set.
advisor.settings.advanced.maxTokensHint: Maximum output tokens per answer; higher costs more.
advisor.settings.advanced.maxInputCharsHint: Maximum characters of conversation sent per call; excess in the middle is elided, head and tail kept.
advisor.settings.advanced.sessionCapHint: Maximum advice items shown per session; once reached only blocker items get through.
advisor.settings.help.calls: Above the limit, the consultation is skipped; 0 = unlimited.
advisor.tail.trace.label: Consultation
advisor.settings.tracePrompt.hint: Stores the first and last 2,000 characters of the text actually sent (after redaction) in the session record; off stores metadata only. If redaction is off, the preview contains raw text.
advisor.tail.trace.previewNone: No sent content saved for this record (older record, or disabled in Advanced).
